title: Purair® SafeSEARCH Ductless Fume Hoods for Forensic and Evidence Examination
meta_title: Purair SafeSEARCH Ductless Fume Hoods - Protect Against Hazardous Drugs and Chemicals
meta_description: The Purair® SafeSEARCH ductless fume hoods are high-efficiency workstations designed to increase protection from drugs, chemical vapors, and particulates during packaging examination.
meta_keywords: purair, safesearch, ductless fume hoods, forensic, evidence examination, hazardous drugs, chemical vapors, particulates
short_description: The Purair® SafeSEARCH ductless fume hoods are a series of high efficiency workstations designed to increase protection from drugs, chemical vapors and particulates during the packaging examination process.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair SafeSEARCH creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including routine or suspicious envelope and package inspection, forensics, evidence examination, mailrooms, airports, bus terminals, vendor receiving bays, government offices, law enforcement, and correctional facilities. The system features a high efficiency EC blower, easy to change filters, and a low airflow alarm to warn of insufficient face velocity. It protects the investigator from hazardous drugs, chemicals, and particulates, with an improved filter clamping design that eliminates bypass leakage outside the cabinet.
seo_content: The Purair SafeSEARCH ductless fume hoods are designed to meet OSHA standards for occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories, providing a safe and compliant solution for a variety of forensic and evidence examination applications. With a range of sizes, configurations, and accessory options, these high-performance workstations can be customized to meet the specific needs of any facility or application.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories
